method: Local MiniLM embeddings propose process strata. Humans approve the full frame. Deterministic constrained largest-deficit quotas start at min(minimum,population), then add a seat to the largest ideal-minus-quota deficit. Within each stratum FNV-1a(seed + NUL + ID), ascending hash then ID, selects without replacement. First-N approved records are the transparent baseline. Reproducible audit planning, not cryptographic randomness, risk scoring or a statistical assurance claim.
